description: This Java class 'KeyNameReviser' provides functionality to revise JSON object key names by replacing problematic characters (such as '.' and '$') with their Unicode equivalents and vice versa. It allows creating instances with specific replacement functions for these transformations, facilitating safe handling of JSON keys in contexts (e.g., MongoDB) where certain characters are restricted.

classes.name: KeyNameReviser
classes.description: A final immutable class implementing Function<String, String> to revise JSON key names by replacing specified characters with their Unicode counterparts or vice versa.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new KeyNameReviser with a provided replace function.

methods.name: escapeProblematicPlainChars
methods.description: Returns a KeyNameReviser that replaces dots and dollar signs with their Unicode representations.

methods.name: decodeKnownUnicodeChars
methods.description: Returns a KeyNameReviser that replaces Unicode dollar and dot characters with their standard representations.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the replace function to a given key name, performing character replacements as configured.
